2317-6763-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1563-2457-4772-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3480-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-4247-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5226-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5226-5777-7810.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

3861-5226-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1424-2335-4613-7891.description:
Activate Woodland Weavemaster using the ability granted to it by Presence of Gond by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters, Woodland Weavemaster triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Woodland Weavemaster using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on Woodland Weavemaster, untapping Woodland Weavemaster.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

851-2757-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1308-6753-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-6753-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1621-2350-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

413-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
413-7096--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from the creature as a state-based action.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3883-5900-7498-7544.description:
Cast a copy of Wheel of Fortune from exile by paying {2}{R}, unpreparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Resolve the copy of Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand, drawing seven cards, and creating seven Treasure tokens for each opponent due to Hullbreacher.
Activate Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding mana.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying that mana, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Repeat.

2440-3581-5223-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-5223-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

232-1235-4863-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3334-4772-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Doubling Season and Lae'zel, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

245-1069-5499-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5499-6968.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

2921-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3525-6006-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4050-4779-6701.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4050-4779-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2060-2921-3705-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-2921-3705-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

4508-5880-5929-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1003-2538-3676-5187.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-5256.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-5256.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, causing target player to mill cards equal to Scourge of the Throne's power.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

1492-3200-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1492-3200-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

1336-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Heronblade Elite
1336-5200.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Heronblade Elite
Repeat.
1336-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1069-1232-2837-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-2837-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

549-1651-4024-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Humans.
549-1651-4024-4050.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Human Soldiers, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1030-1379-1651-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1379-1651-4659-4840.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2034-2757-2820-4668.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Heliod, untapping the Plains.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and return Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Angelic Renewal by paying {1}{W}.
Repeat.

315-399-1661-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metallic Sliver, adding {C}{C}.
Metallic Sliver is put on top of your library instead of your graveyard due to its ability granted by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast Metallic Sliver from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

984-1624-3625.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
984-1624-3625.description:
Cast Awakened Awareness by paying {U}{U}, attaching it to Tree of Redemption.
On the end step prior to your next turn, activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

92-1545-4658.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-1545-4658.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
